title: Catch a reversed pair
prompt: A candidate method takes two strings and should join them with a slash, the first argument first: `"west"` and `"east"` give `"west/east"`. Write `public static bool OrderCheck(Func<string, string, string> candidate)`. Return true for a correct candidate. Return false for a faulty one that joins them in reverse order, and for one that leaves out the slash.
hints: Would two equal inputs tell the two orders apart?
Choose two different strings, so that swapping them changes the result.
Call candidate with two different strings and compare the result with the exact text you expect.
checkLabels: A correct candidate must pass your check.
A candidate that joins in reverse order must fail your check.
A candidate that leaves out the slash must fail your check.

wrongAnswers.misconception: Uses two equal strings, so both orders look the same.
Writes the expected text in the wrong order.

feedback: Pick inputs for which a reversed result looks different from a correct one, and write the expected text straight from the rule.
